_comment: spec 008 thresholds & config — the one place quality bounds live (FR-010).

anomaly_detection._comment: domain-agnostic detectors. robust-z ONLY on bounded/unimodal columns — a skewed level variable (GDP) false-positives on genuinely rich/poor entities; use YoY there instead (spec 008 Q4).
anomaly_detection._note: robust-z + yoy ONLY on life_expectancy — the one column with tight global bounds and a smooth series. fertility/internet/GDP have legitimate wide spread (e.g. Mauritius' low fertility), so robust-z false-positives there; static value_ranges above still catch clear impossibilities for every column.
